messages:
maria: Heads up — need final gating call for the Snowflake / Databricks / vector DB joint launch. Legal, eng, SI, and marketplace owners please confirm readiness by EOD Thurs.

tom: Quick list of launch items so we're aligned: marketplace listing, joint blog, partner webinar, SI POC bundles, telemetry & perf smoke tests. Anything else?

anita: Marketplace listing mostly done, but telemetry manifest + sample events still outstanding. Also need packaging notes for SI installers.

seb-engineering: Working on telemetry schema now. ETA tomorrow 12:00 UTC. Question for product: do we send tenant-scoped events or aggregated metrics to the marketplace?

dwight: From SI side: we need a staging tenant + sample dataset + clear onboarding README. We have 3 SI integrators who'll test — can we provide creds and a scoped S3 read-only bucket?

maria: We have a staging bundle but infra requires ephemeral creds and scoped perms. Ops wants an explicit rotation plan before we hand anything to partners.

jane-legal: Legal reminder: demos must not contain customer data. Checklist for launch: 1) Redaction enabled on ingest 2) No PII in sample datasets 3) Logs masked. Send proof for #1-3 before we sign off on public blog/webinar.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: marketplace-preview v0.9 -> staging at 2025-06-05T02:00Z by @seb-engineering.

tom: @seb-engineering can you paste a tiny sample event we can embed in the marketplace manifest? Need format for QA and docs.

seb-engineering: Sample event (will be in repo): `{"event":"ingest_start","tenant":"staging-123","doc_count":42}`. We'll also add a SHA256 signature header example for verification.

anita: :thumbsup: that's enough for the manifest. @maria can ops create ephemeral staging creds with S3 read-only + token expiry 24h? We'll use that for SI POCs.

maria: I'll ping infra to create creds. Ops question: who should be on the rotation notification list? plz share SI contacts.

dwight: I'll DM the SI contacts. Also partner asked for a webinar dry-run next Tue. Can we align that with your staging availability?

maria: Timeline proposal: deploy -> smoke tests -> creds -> SI dry run -> partner webinar. If preview deploy is Thu, dry run Mon works.

jane-legal: One more legal note: joint blog cannot include partner revenue or pricing specifics. Send blog draft to legal at least 48h pre-publish.

seb-engineering: I'll open a tiny PR in /marketplace/docs with telemetry manifest + smoke test command: `curl -H 'X-Sign: <sig>' https://staging.marketplace.redwood/ping`

tom: Great. Final GA gating criteria from product/ops: ingest success rate >99% for 1h, median latency <200ms, zero PII hits in eval set. Pass/fail to be posted here.

maria: Noted. I'll compile the pass/fail checklist and post Friday AM.
